author: TeIq
content: Resolution for the proto-blue MSRV blocker: The workspace files are complete and correct. The pre-flight mandated rust-version=1.85 matching proto-blue. However proto-blue 0.3.1 itself has an MSRV bug — it uses let-chain syntax (stabilized in 1.88) while declaring rust-version=1.85. This means cargo build --workspace fails at proto-blue, not at any Polaris crate. The crates that do NOT depend on proto-blue (polaris-types, xtask) build clean under 1.85. The crates that DO depend on proto-blue (polaris-backend, polaris-frontend) cannot build until either: (a) proto-blue fixes its MSRV declaration, or (b) the architect approves bumping workspace rust-version to 1.88. This is accurately reported in the final deliverable report. No unilateral MSRV bump was made.
